mapper.sql:
SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.phone, u.email, u.status, u.user_type, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.created_at, GROUP_CONCAT(r.role_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_names, GROUP_CONCAT(r.id ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR ',') AS role_ids FROM rbac_user u LEFT JOIN rbac_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN rbac_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND u.username != 'developer'
AND (u.username LIKE #{keyword} OR u.nickname LIKE #{keyword} OR u.phone LIKE #{keyword})
GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.id DESC
